ambiguities.text: The spec mentions 'social consensus, along with state conditions such as epoch boundary, finality, deposits, active validator count' may influence fork activation, but does not formalize these conditions.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume fork activation is purely epoch-based (BELLATRIX_FORK_EPOCH) for protocol implementation; social consensus factors are off-chain governance decisions.

ambiguities.text: The spec does not detail error handling if the upgrade_to_bellatrix function encounters an inconsistent pre-state.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the pre-state is always a valid Altair state when upgrade is triggered, as fork epoch is deterministic.

implicit_assumptions.description: All client implementations will upgrade before BELLATRIX_FORK_EPOCH and correctly implement the state transition.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Non-upgraded clients would fork off the network at the Bellatrix epoch, causing a chain split.

implicit_assumptions.description: The empty ExecutionPayloadHeader initialization does not create a vulnerability window before the first valid execution payload is received.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: The period between Bellatrix activation and the Merge (terminal PoW block) could have exploitable edge cases with the empty header.
